dataset.rule: Family partitions remain unchanged. Holdout is not run until candidate, versions, budget and criteria freeze.

keyClaimSemanticSupport.denominator: all assessable key claims, paired and averaged by family

followupRelevance.denominator: all followups requiring review, averaged by family

unsupportedMajorCorrection.denominator: all major corrections; also report affected-case fraction; zero corrections is not accuracy evidence

latency.environment: fixed local machine, healthy dependencies, 2 workers, at most 8 SSE connections

reviewProtocol.procedure: Hide route, randomize order, judge source support, technical correctness and relevance independently; double-review disputed items and at least 20 percent of remaining items.
reviewProtocol.denominator: All accepted cases, including failed, expired, cancelled and unknown usage. Aggregate by family, not by turn.
reviewProtocol.uncertainty: Report paired difference and confidence intervals. Insufficient samples or interval crossing zero is INCONCLUSIVE. Unknown unbounded usage cannot prove a cost gate.
reviewProtocol.modelJudge: Assistance only; never the sole final semantic score.

currentReleaseDecision: NOT_READY: P1 full G1, P2-P4, G35 and final V have not passed. Location checks and HTTP success are not semantic quality evidence.
